from humanize.number import _METRIC_PREFIXES

value = 0.000001
abs_value = abs(value)

        prefix = name
        divisor = threshold
        print(f'  -> MATCH!')
        break

print(f'Result: prefix={prefix}, divisor={divisor}')
scaled = value / divisor
print(f'Scaled: {scaled}')
